Rapha Melbourne Social Saturday Ride

Melbourne, Australia · Albert Park · Road

Rapha Melbourne Social Saturday Ride is a road group ride in Melbourne, Australia. It rolls every Saturday at 8:00 am local time from Halcyon Days (Beach Rd and Westside routes).

For visitors

Made for riders new to group riding or after a relaxed bunch ride. Road or gravel bike with clip-in pedals, helmet, spare tube and repair kit. The Bonds Rd route starts at Advanced Vetcare in Kew (Chandler Highway and Yarra Boulevard). Book on Rapha's events site.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: about 25 km/h (Bonds Rd), 28 km/h (Beach Rd), 25 km/h (Westside); no-drop. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Rapha Melbourne Social Saturday Ride group ride

A relaxed Saturday bunch ride from Rapha Melbourne with three routes that rotate. It is a no-drop ride for people new to group riding, with coffee before the start on two routes.
